# Draws on one shared stock: every combination fits exactly when the total does

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Of the first n draws, given as natural numbers, every selection fits within the stock exactly when their total does.

Canonical source: [CorrectionDependence.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/meta-attractor/CorrectionDependence.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The draws are natural numbers that add; the stock is the one quantity they all draw on.

In the source model, each draw is the work an activity needs to stop without its transition loss, and the stock is what is set aside for that work. The numbers are not a general measure of value; their correspondence to actual activities and stocks needs separate evidence.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

Each draw fitting alone does not make them fit together: two draws of two units each can compete for one stock of two.

Boundary source: [CorrectionDependence.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/meta-attractor/CorrectionDependence.lean)
